_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: Engineered Wood RePaint. ENSD prefix consumed by NC sibling. EWRP has zero collision.

paintable_items.name: Exterior siding field surface — net paintable area
paintable_items.notes: Shared across wood siding, fiber cement siding, and engineered wood siding specs (NC and RP). Already in id_registry.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_ENSD_* used by NC. TSK_FCRP_* used by FC RP. TSK_EWRP_* has zero existing usage.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_EWRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based (LANDSCAPE_PROTECT, POWER_WASH_LOW, SCRAPE_FEATHER, PRIME_SPRAY_BACKROLL, FINISH_1_SPRAY_BACKROLL)

expected_modules.description: Landscape/hardscape protection, fixture masking, vehicle/driveway, equipment setup
Condition assessment: visual, adhesion, chalk, moisture, edge seal, caulk
Power wash, scrape/feather, degloss/scuff, chalk remediation, mildew treatment, caulk remove/replace, moisture check, dust cleanup
State-driven primer: chalk-binding, acrylic stain-block, bonding. spray_backroll or brush_roll.
Finish coats 1 and 2 by spray_backroll or brush_roll
Interstage inspection, QT4 intercoat sand, touch-up, dust removal
Final inspection, final touch-up, protection teardown, equipment cleanup, site cleanup, customer walkthrough
Shared exterior lead-safe RRP module. Conditional on pre_1978 = true.

paintscope_keys.description: Net paintable siding field area per elevation
LF of caulk joints requiring assessment/replacement

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_EXT_EW_PRIMER_ACRYLIC (NC acrylic primer — NOT directly reusable, different application context)
SYS_EXT_EW_PRIMER_BONDING (NC bonding primer — reusable for exposed ExpertFinish)
SYS_EXT_EW_FINISH_STANDARD (NC standard finish — reusable, same product)
SYS_EXT_EW_FINISH_PREMIUM (NC premium finish — reusable, same product)
material_system_prefix.notes: RP needs 2 new primer systems: SYS_EXT_EWRP_PRIMER_ACRYLIC_RP (stain-block for RP) and SYS_EXT_EWRP_PRIMER_CHALK_BIND (chalk-binding). Finish systems and bonding primer reuse NC systems.

proposed.description: 2 finish coats only (GOOD condition, no prime)
1 finish coat only (QT2 economy, GOOD condition)
State-driven prime + 1 finish coat (QT2 economy, FAIR/POOR)

factor_modifiers.name: Condition Scale Prep Modifier
factor_modifiers.notes: Same pattern as FC RP. Never applies to coating tasks.

factor_modifiers.name: Siding Profile Modifier
factor_modifiers.notes: Panel is faster in RP (spray_backroll on large flat areas). NC panel=1.10. RP panel=0.90. Same as FC RP pattern.

factor_modifiers.name: Surface Texture Modifier
factor_modifiers.notes: 2 textures (smooth/textured) vs NC's 3. Textured combines cedarmill/roughsawn — existing paint film moderates difference.

factor_modifiers.name: Quality Tier Coating Modifier
factor_modifiers.notes: Same pattern as FC RP. Never applies to prep tasks.

stacking_partition.prep_pool: condition x rrp x access x profile x texture
stacking_partition.coating_pool: qt x access x profile x texture
stacking_partition.never_cross: Prep pool never includes QT. Coating pool never includes condition or RRP.
stacking_partition.worst_case_prep: POOR(2.0) x RRP(2.0) x scaffold(1.60) x lap(1.00) x textured(1.15) = 7.36x — extreme, realistic for pre-1978 peeling EW
stacking_partition.worst_case_coating: QT4(1.30) x scaffold(1.60) x lap(1.00) x textured(1.15) = 2.39x — within 4.0x cap

cross_spec_coordination.notes: No cross-spec flags. RRP containment shared with other exterior RP specs (deduplication per U-004).

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
